steps.title: Set up
steps.instruction: Step your left foot beside your left hand. Keep the back leg long.

steps.title: Lower
steps.instruction: Bring your left elbow toward the inside of your front foot.

steps.title: Rotate
steps.instruction: Turn your chest left and reach your left hand up. Follow it with your eyes.

steps.title: Set up
steps.instruction: Start on hands and knees. Put your hands under your shoulders.

steps.title: Thread
steps.instruction: Slide your left arm under your right arm, palm facing up.

steps.title: Hold
steps.instruction: Lower your left shoulder and the side of your head to the mat. Keep your hips over your knees.

steps.title: Set up
steps.instruction: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and your feet planted.

steps.title: Front leg
steps.instruction: Lower your left knee. Bring that shin across your body, with the knee bent to 90°.

steps.title: Back leg
steps.instruction: Fold your right leg behind you, also at 90°. Rest both legs on the floor.

steps.title: Lean
steps.instruction: Keep your chest long. Lean from your hips over your front shin.

steps.title: Set up
steps.instruction: Lie on your back with your arms beside you, palms down.

steps.title: Lift
steps.instruction: Bring your legs up together. Keep your head still.

steps.title: Roll
steps.instruction: Lift your hips and slowly take your legs over your head.

steps.title: Hold
steps.instruction: Reach your toes toward the floor behind your head. Keep your weight on your shoulders.

steps.title: Set up
steps.instruction: Kneel on your right knee. Plant your left foot in front.

steps.title: Tuck
steps.instruction: Tuck your pelvis and gently squeeze your right glute.

steps.title: Hold
steps.instruction: Keep your chest upright. Shift slightly forward until the front of your right hip stretches.

steps.title: Stand
steps.instruction: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.

steps.title: Fold
steps.instruction: Bend at your hips and reach your hands toward the floor.

steps.title: Hold
steps.instruction: Relax your neck. Keep a small bend in your knees if needed.

steps.title: Set up
steps.instruction: Fold forward and place your hands on the floor.

steps.title: Bend one knee
steps.instruction: Keep your hands down. Bend one knee while the other leg lengthens.

steps.title: Switch
steps.instruction: Slowly straighten that leg as you bend the other knee.

steps.title: Set up
steps.instruction: Start on hands and knees, with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.

steps.title: Round
steps.instruction: Push the floor away. Round your back and let your head drop.

steps.title: Arch
steps.instruction: Gently lower your belly and lift your chest. Move slowly between the two positions.

steps.title: Stand
steps.instruction: Stand tall and let your shoulders relax.

steps.title: Reach back
steps.instruction: Bend your left elbow and place the back of your hand against your lower back.

steps.title: Slide up
steps.instruction: Gently slide your hand upward. Keep your chest still and avoid forcing the movement.
